conventions.rule: Provider integrations go exclusively through the Vercel AI SDK, never bespoke per-provider HTTP clients
Persistence code routes through durable-io.ts/atomic-file.ts instead of writing files directly
Source filenames use kebab-case throughout src/
Ambiguous states are modeled as typed string-literal unions rather than booleans or thrown exceptions
Tests prefer real file I/O in temp directories over vi.mock (used in only 11 of 73 test files)
No coverage tooling or gate is configured
oxlint enforces only the correctness rule category as an error, ESLint is not used
CLI subcommand handlers live in *-command.ts modules, state-owning modules live in *-store.ts modules
Custom provider endpoint URLs must pass the SSRF guard in url-security.ts before use
Root .gitignore uses an allowlist pattern (deny-all plus explicit unignores) instead of a blocklist
Risky state mutations follow a transactional-journal-reconcile pattern that self-repairs an interrupted run on the next invocation
Timeout/deadline logic is abstracted behind an injectable Clock port for deterministic testing
